title: Stage 1
objective: Complete the Sector 1 mission and survive.

contact.name: Commander Elena Vail
contact.message: Pilot, this is the prototype. You take orders from me only.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Look at her—perfect. Touch her with dirty hands and I'll break your finger.

dialogueSequence.name: Commander Elena Vail
dialogueSequence.message: Pilot, this is the prototype. You take orders from me only.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: See? She's perfect. Touch her with dirty hands and I'll snap your finger.

title: Stage 2
objective: Complete the Sector 2 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: My weapons are the most precise in the galaxy. Use them properly.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Weapons are ready. Use them well—she doesn't like unnecessary noise.

title: Stage 3
objective: Complete the Sector 3 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: The shield's about to crack! Are you completely reckless?! Get back here!

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her shield nearly cracked!

title: Stage 4
objective: Complete the Sector 4 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: I fixed the scratch. She's perfect again. Bring a cloth.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: I repaired her. I brought a soft cloth.

title: Stage 5
objective: Complete the Sector 5 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Watch her glide. This isn't a ship—it's a work of art.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: She slips through the asteroids like she was born for it.

title: Stage 6
objective: Complete the Sector 6 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: The engine shuddered! I'm bringing it hot oil right away. And you'll get hit if that happens again!

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her engine shuddered. She doesn't like being rattled.

title: Stage 7
objective: Complete the Sector 7 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: I upgraded the cooling. She's even more perfect now. Thank me later.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: I upgraded her cooling. She's more stable now.

title: Stage 8
objective: Complete the Sector 8 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: If you come back with dust on her, I'll smash you over the head with a Swedish wrench.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: If you return with dust on her, I'll crack you over the head.

title: Stage 9
objective: Complete the Sector 9 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: That last maneuver was flawless. I'm so proud of her I could cry.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: The last maneuver was precise. She loved it.

title: Stage 10
objective: Complete the Sector 10 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Protect her like your life depends on it. Your life is less important than hers.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Protect her. Your life is less important than hers.

title: Stage 11
objective: Complete the Sector 11 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.message: Who is this?

dialogueSequence.message: Pilot—I've breached the channel. Paid targets.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Who is this?

objective: Complete the Sector 12 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Commander Elena Vail
inMissionComms.message: Official order: eliminate.

afterAction.name: Commander Elena Vail
afterAction.message: Official order: eliminate.

objective: Complete the Sector 13 mission and survive.

contact.name: Dr. Naomi Ren

inMissionComms.message: He's near Orion.

objective: Complete the Sector 14 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her shield almost broke!

title: Stage 15
objective: Complete the Sector 15 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Commander Elena Vail
inMissionComms.message: Return. Report.

afterAction.name: Commander Elena Vail
afterAction.message: Return. Report.

title: Stage 16
objective: Complete the Sector 16 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: My weapons are aching for her. Let them do their work.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her weapons are waiting.

objective: Complete the Sector 17 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: GHOST

afterAction.name: GHOST
afterAction.message: Nebula Sel dust clouds.

objective: Complete the Sector 18 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: It's just a reflection from the stars, I swear!

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Hey, why did you do that?!

title: Stage 19
objective: Complete the Sector 19 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Commander Elena Vail
inMissionComms.message: Report, then rest.

afterAction.name: Commander Elena Vail
afterAction.message: Report, then rest.

title: Stage 20
objective: Complete the Sector 20 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: All I smell is fresh oil. And a little of your sweat.

afterAction.message: She only smells fresh oil. And a Big Mac.

title: Stage 21
objective: Complete the Sector 21 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Watch her maneuver. This isn't flying—it's dancing.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Leaving.

objective: Complete the Sector 22 mission and survive.

contact.message: They're carrying something the military wants.

inMissionComms.message: Proceed.

dialogueSequence.name: GHOST
dialogueSequence.message: They're carrying something the military wants.

afterAction.name: Commander Elena Vail
afterAction.message: Proceed.

title: Stage 23
objective: Complete the Sector 23 mission and survive.

contact.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
contact.message: Another little blot next to the old one!

inMissionComms.message: It's light from the rear window...

dialogueSequence.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
dialogueSequence.message: Another little blot next to the old one!

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: It's a light...

title: Stage 24
objective: Complete the Sector 24 mission and survive.

contact.name: GHOST
contact.message: The military is silent about the incursions.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: I fixed the pressure sensor. Now it's as precise as I like. Almost as precise as me.

dialogueSequence.name: GHOST
dialogueSequence.message: The military is silent about the incursions.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: I fixed her pressure sensor. I tried another solvent on the stain. Nothing.

title: Stage 25
objective: Complete the Sector 25 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Bring back cosmic dust and I'll wallop you with my beautiful Swedish wrench.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Dust on my ship and you'll meet my Swedish wrench.

title: Stage 26
objective: Complete the Sector 26 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: The last maneuver was perfect. I'm prouder of her than of myself — and that's saying something.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her maneuver was precise.

title: Stage 27
objective: Complete the Sector 27 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Finally—an order that keeps her safe. Credit to whoever wrote it.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Finally—an order that keeps her safe.

title: Stage 28
objective: Complete the Sector 28 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: The only tech that matters is mine. Someone copied me — and I'll find them.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Someone copied it. I strongly suspect it's my father.

title: Stage 29
objective: Complete the Sector 29 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: She has a similar ship?! Who copied my design?! Probably that idiot, Professor Rahav!

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: She has a similar ship. Definitely Rahav — no one else could pull that off.

title: Stage 30
objective: Complete the Sector 30 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: If she touches my ship I'll strip it down and rebuild it better. And I'll kill Rahav.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: If she touches it I'll dismantle it. Rahav will be dealt with afterward.

title: Stage 31
objective: Complete the Sector 31 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: My weapons are ready. They're the most precise. Rahav probably stole the idea for them too.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her weapons are ready.

title: Stage 32
objective: Complete the Sector 32 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: Ready.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Ready.

objective: Complete the Sector 33 assignment and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: There's a scratch! That fool Rahav stole parts of her tech — I'll kill him!

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: She's got a scratch. Rahav probably stole parts from her. No one else knows how she's built.

title: Stage 34
objective: Complete the Sector 34 assignment and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: I asked for quiet and got thieves and scratches. Rahav — I know it was you!

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: I've been left with thieves and scratches. Rahav...

title: Stage 35
objective: Complete the Sector 35 assignment and survive.

inMissionComms.name: GHOST
inMissionComms.message: Elena — this is rotten.

afterAction.name: GHOST
afterAction.message: Elena — this is rotten.

title: Stage 36
objective: Complete the Sector 36 assignment and survive.

contact.name: GHOST
contact.message: Sera still thinks she's the best.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Only if she isn't harmed. Otherwise I'm staying — I'll kill them all, Rahav included, from a distance.

dialogueSequence.name: GHOST
dialogueSequence.message: Sera still thinks she's the best.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Don't start.

title: Stage 37
objective: Complete the Sector 37 assignment and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Initiating escape. My engines sing—listen how beautiful they are. It's not you, it's them.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Elena, haven't you felt something's been off here for a long time?

title: Stage 38
objective: Complete the Sector 38 assignment and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: If anyone touches her during the chase I'll find them. And Rahav too.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Sometimes I ask who we're really working for.

title: Stage 39
objective: Complete the Sector 39 assignment and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: We're fleeing. No time for AC.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Target neutralized. Again.

title: Stage 40
objective: Complete the Sector 40 assignment and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: Maybe we'll fix it when we stop.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: This silence is starting to feel dangerous.

title: Stage 41
objective: Complete the Sector 41 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: My weapons are hungry. So am I—the A/C's out and it's boiling in here.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: What if we see something we're not supposed to?

objective: Complete the Sector 42 mission and survive.

contact.name: GHOST
contact.message: Large alien movements. The fleet is looking the other way.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: At least he's dead.

dialogueSequence.name: GHOST
dialogueSequence.message: Large alien movements. The fleet is looking the other way.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: How many more times can we look the other way?

objective: Complete the Sector 43 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: We'll fix the A/C later.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Do you really still believe it's just orders?

objective: Complete the Sector 44 mission and survive.

contact.name: GHOST
contact.message: There's a clear link between the incursions and the technology.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: I did press the button...

dialogueSequence.name: GHOST
dialogueSequence.message: There's a clear link between the incursions and the technology.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Someone's playing a game far bigger than us.

objective: Complete the Sector 45 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: I was the one who aimed it...

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: What if this time it doesn't end in a tie?

objective: Complete the Sector 46 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Less important than the broken A/C—I'm dying of heat!

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Only if she isn't harmed. Otherwise I'm staying.

title: Stage 47
objective: Complete the Sector 47 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: My weapons tore it apart. Flawless. And I'm still as hot as an oven.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Initiating escape. Her engines are stable.

objective: Complete the Sector 48 mission and survive.

contact.name: Commander Elena Vail
contact.message: The whole fleet is pursuing you!

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: I fixed the A/C! Finally. She's perfect again and I'm not sweating.

dialogueSequence.name: Commander Elena Vail
dialogueSequence.message: The whole fleet is pursuing you!

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: If anyone lays a hand on her—I will find them.

objective: Complete the Sector 49 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: If they touch her, I'll reduce them to dust with cross-dimensional energy. Watch.

dialogueSequence.name: Commander Elena Vail
dialogueSequence.message: Pilot, stand by. Naomi—this could cost you everything.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her engine shuddered. She's tired.

objective: Complete the Sector 50 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Don't get close! That fool Rahav stole my tech—I know it!

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: We're entering an asteroid belt. She hates tight spaces.

objective: Complete the Sector 51 mission and survive.

contact.name: Dr. Naomi Ren

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: I'm freezing time for a moment. Look—what a capability. It's not the pilot; it's me.

dialogueSequence.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
dialogueSequence.message: Her viewports are clogged with dust!

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Flying by sensors.

objective: Complete the Sector 52 mission and survive.

contact.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
contact.message: Her wing's scratched! The stain is still there! I've tried every compound in the universe except a spatula!

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: The shield nearly cracked from that surge! Pilot—this is on you! And Rahav stole my shield concept!

dialogueSequence.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
dialogueSequence.message: Her wing's scratched! The stain is still there! I've tried every compound in the universe except a spatula!

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Maybe…

objective: Complete the Sector 53 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: I siphoned energy from a parallel dimension. Weapons are twice as strong now. Pure pride.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: That's the vibration.

objective: Complete the Sector 54 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Sera Kane
inMissionComms.message: I'm still on your tail.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot

inMissionComms.message: What are these readings?

dialogueSequence.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
dialogueSequence.message: There are chips scattered on her deck!

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Later!

objective: Complete the Sector 56 mission and survive.

contact.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
contact.message: Her nav is showing three trajectories!

inMissionComms.message: I'm freezing time again. Watch—perfect. The pilot just presses buttons.

dialogueSequence.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
dialogueSequence.message: Her nav is showing three trajectories!

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Choosing one.

objective: Complete the Sector 57 mission. Survive.

inMissionComms.name: Sera Kane
inMissionComms.message: You stop while I'm on your tail? Have some nerve.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Almost there.

objective: Complete the Sector 58 mission. Survive.

inMissionComms.name: Commander Elena Vail
inMissionComms.message: (Secure) You have a small window. I'm holding reinforcements.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot

objective: Complete the Sector 59 mission. Survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Yes. And they stole my tech. Rahav—idiot. I'll kill him.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: We're clear!

objective: Complete the Sector 60 mission. Survive.

contact.name: Sera Kane
contact.message: Found you. I'm on your tail.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Finally she's settling. Now I can fix the AC again—it's wheezing.

dialogueSequence.name: Sera Kane
dialogueSequence.message: Found you. I'm on your tail.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: She's broken. Rahav's probably proud of the flying heap he built her.

title: Stage 61
objective: Complete the Sector 61 mission. Survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: Finally.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Time stop—use it. She needs a moment. Rahav never taught her patience.

objective: Complete the Sector 62 mission. Survive.

contact.name: Commander Elena Vail
contact.message: (Secure) Sera has orders to destroy. I'm stalling.

inMissionComms.message: I've upgraded the time-stop. Three seconds now. Isn't that beautiful?

dialogueSequence.name: Commander Elena Vail
dialogueSequence.message: (Secure) Sera has orders to destroy. I'm stalling.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her shield nearly fractured!

title: Stage 63
objective: Complete the Sector 63 mission. Survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: My weapons are hungry. I'm so proud of them I almost forget Rahav.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: I siphoned energy from her. Her weapons are stable—unlike my father's shiny toys that only draw fire.

title: Stage 64
objective: Complete the Sector 64 mission. Survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: I pressed the button hard this time.

afterAction.name: Sera Kane
afterAction.message: I see.

title: Stage 65
objective: Complete the Sector 65 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: I've siphoned a massive charge. Now she's singing—perfect. Rahav would be jealous.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her generator's still weak. Unlike Rahav's scrapheap that only rattles and irritates.

title: Stage 66
objective: Complete the Sector 66 mission and survive.

contact.name: Sera Kane
contact.message: I'm pushing on... but the readings—

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: My weapons will handle it. They're the best. And I am the one who built them.

dialogueSequence.name: Sera Kane
dialogueSequence.message: I'm pushing on... but the readings—

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Stopping time again. She needs silence—unlike my father's noisy ship that wrecks every soundscape.

title: Stage 67
objective: Complete the Sector 67 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: They hit us—now they're firing!

afterAction.name: Sera Kane
afterAction.message: You're pausing to hunt?!

title: Stage 68
objective: Complete the Sector 68 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: Well done.

afterAction.name: Commander Elena Vail
afterAction.message: (SECURE) There's a window. I'm holding reinforcements.

title: Stage 69
objective: Complete the Sector 69 mission and survive.

contact.name: Sera Kane
contact.message: The readings... and an order from the Belt...

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: I stop time for a full three seconds. Watch. Perfect. The pilot just watches.

dialogueSequence.name: Sera Kane
dialogueSequence.message: The readings... and an order from the Belt...

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Yes. Rahav stole parts from her. Now his scrap is wrecking the composition of the whole sector.

title: Stage 70
objective: Complete the Sector 70 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: The weapons sing when they fire. Hear that? It's my upgrade.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Finally. Now we can try the effect again.

title: Stage 71
objective: Complete the Sector 71 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: No one touches it.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: I repaired her generator.

title: Stage 72
objective: Complete the Sector 72 mission and survive.

contact.name: GHOST

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: AC's perfect. Engines sing. Weapons hot. I'm proud of every centimeter.

dialogueSequence.name: GHOST
dialogueSequence.message: Relative silence. Rahav sent an arrogant message.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: I upgraded her time-stop. Not like Rahav's clunky engineering.

title: Stage 73
objective: Complete Sector 73 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Let them come. I've tapped extra‑dimensional energy and a time‑freeze. They don't know what they're up against.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her weapons are ready.

title: Stage 74
objective: Complete Sector 74 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: Later!

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Firing.

title: Stage 75
objective: Complete Sector 75 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: Well done.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: I fed her extra energy.

title: Stage 76
objective: Complete Sector 76 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: I freeze time, siphon power, fire—perfection. And the pilot just sits there.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Her weapons will handle it. Not like Professor Rahav's flashy guns that only draw needless attention.

title: Stage 77
objective: Complete Sector 77 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: My weapons tore them apart before they knew what hit them. Pure pride.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Hey—why did you do that?!

title: Stage 78
objective: Complete Sector 78 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Program Zero Pilot
inMissionComms.message: Magic — I press a button.

afterAction.name: Program Zero Pilot
afterAction.message: Thanks.

inMissionComms.message: Engines singing, AC perfect, weapons ready. I'm proud.

dialogueSequence.name: Commander Elena Vail
dialogueSequence.message: (Private) Sera, the window's open. If you go through, I'll cover you.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: A brief time‑freeze.

title: Stage 80
objective: Complete Sector 80 mission and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
inMissionComms.message: Welcome. Just don't touch my ship. And Professor Rahav stays on the blacklist.

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Welcome. Don't touch her. And tell my father's flying heap to stay out of formation.

title: Stage 81
objective: Complete Sector 81 objectives and survive.

inMissionComms.name: Sera Kane
inMissionComms.message: I'm going first. I'm the best.

afterAction.name: Sera Kane
afterAction.message: I went first—I'm faster!

title: Stage 82

afterAction.name: Dr. Naomi Ren
afterAction.message: Full epilogue: The mothership's core detonated the moment the Pilot destroyed its system. Sera dragged him from the wreckage and the two slipped into an independent patrol along Ark‑9's border, with a quiet, suggestive hint of something more. I executed flawless digital revenge on my father, Professor Rahav—broadcasting his corruption across the galaxy and locking down his lab. Commander Elena purged the command and offered the Pilot and Sera independent authority. The aliens withdrew through distant gates, and GHOST has already picked up a new signal on the Dark Web.
